items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: I remember we played one with George Lee, who was from Kansas City.

ctx.x: What about the battles of music that you had with the Troy Floyd?

That used to be a gate attraction. Never was a winner, never was a loser. I remember we played one with George Lee, who was from Kansas City. George had a tremendous band. And George was a great singer, George E. Lee. That's Julia Lee's brother. Well, we packed the place, two bands, and we walked off as winners, I guess. Then later on, years of my band, I had a lot of battle of bands. Because that was one way of enticing the public in.
I know you tell me about meeting many different people. What about Walter Page?
